name: Accepted turn enters adjudication
description: Rule-pack STUB for the starter world. It matches the one transition the world-loading slice can honestly assert exists: a turn entity written by intake in phase 'accepted'. The adjudicator action is deliberately absent because the persona loop, the dice component, and the effect applier are not built yet; task group 8 authors the real sequencing chain, with an iteration cap on every LLM-triggering path. Structural notes carried forward: the trigger is eq + on_enter rather than the transition operator, because a transition condition cannot fire on an entity's FIRST write and a turn entity is created directly in 'accepted' (design finding F3); the matched field is three-segment lower-kebab because the write gate rejects anything else (F2).
